value.rationale: A precisely admissible counterexample falsifies the transferable direction of a practical, previously used sensitivity comparison without disputing the published trace statistic or empirical analysis. The dimension, correlation constraint and opposite signs are substantive features. This is useful as a correctness benchmark for signed-correlation models, not merely a numerical difference between two norms.
